key_fields.name: CUSTOMER-RECORD
key_fields.meaning: 500-byte customer master record (comment RECLN 500; field sizes add up to 500).

key_fields.name: CUST-ID
key_fields.meaning: 9-digit customer id, key of the customer file.

key_fields.name: CUST-LAST-NAME
key_fields.meaning: Customer last name (with CUST-FIRST-NAME and CUST-MIDDLE-NAME, 25 bytes each).

key_fields.name: CUST-ADDR-ZIP
key_fields.meaning: ZIP code; together with three address lines, state and country codes forms the postal address.

key_fields.name: CUST-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD
key_fields.meaning: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD text form.

key_fields.name: CUST-PRI-CARD-HOLDER-IND
key_fields.meaning: Primary card holder indicator (1 byte, no 88-levels).

observations.text: CUSTREC defines the same layout under the same 01 name but calls the birth-date field CUST-DOB-YYYYMMDD; the two copybooks are near-duplicates.

purpose: CVCUS01Y defines CUSTOMER-RECORD, the standard 500-byte customer master entity: id, names, address, phones, SSN, government id, date of birth, EFT account id, primary card holder indicator and FICO score. It is used by the print utility CBCUS01C, migration programs CBEXPORT and CBIMPORT, CBTRN01C and online programs (COACTUPC, COACTVWC, COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC, COPAUA0C, COPAUS0C).
